podcast.title: Precursor to Arctic Monkeys' New Sound
podcast.body: The last album released by The Last Shadow Puppets is noted for already hinting at a very different sound from Alex Turner, laying a path for the stylistic shift later seen in the Arctic Monkeys' new work. This project provided a context for understanding the evolution of Turner's musical direction. "El álbum que había sacado hace poco los ASEADO PAPETS iba un poco hacia ese camino y ya veíamos una alestarnos muy distinto."

xref.title: First Century Mod
xref.body: Jake Bugg is identified as one of the "first century mods," indicating a contemporary artist who embodies or is influenced by the mod aesthetic and cultural leanings. "Many first century mods include Jake Bug and Miles Kane of the last Shadow Puppets."
